description: MARTA rail station parking, hand-verified from MARTA's official pages. Used only for 'drive to a MARTA station, then ride' options. Station ids are GTFS parent stations in the MARTA feed (data/published/commute/transit-gt.json). Space availability is never known; only whether the station has parking and what it costs.

marta-long-term-rates.title: MARTA increases long-term parking rates (press release, Aug 20, 2026)

rules.freeDaily: Free daily parking at the stations listed with freeDaily: true.
rules.paidFacilities: From Sept 14, 2026, paid long-term facilities are free for the first 14 hours, then charge the station's daily rate.

stations.name: North Springs
stations.note: Exit the same way you came in; two parking decks.

stations.name: Lindbergh Center
stations.note: Parking is behind MARTA Headquarters (off Sidney Marcus Blvd).

notListed: Brookhaven/Oglethorpe parking is marked temporarily unavailable. Stations without parking (e.g. Five Points, Buckhead, Arts Center, Midtown, North Avenue, Airport) are never used as park-and-ride points.
